text: Football tells more than a scoreline. MatchWeave turns synthetic match events into explainable intelligence, giving fans, analysts and broadcasters a different, factually consistent story.

Replay five fictional matches with nearly ten thousand events. Python calculates transparent possession, passing, shot and momentum proxies. No real pressure events or player movement are invented from a scoreline.

Real match lab adds twelve thousand three hundred seventy two completed matches across eight competitions. Twenty twenty six, twenty seven is excluded. A chronological holdout measures actual model performance.

Each tactical story includes its comparison window, sample limit and exact source events. Open the evidence to inspect the independent recount. These are observed patterns, without a claim that they caused a goal.

A real Microsoft Agent Framework graph coordinates five Foundry Local specialists. This is a recorded local run. Inspect its handoffs and tool calculations. An injected false count is rejected, repaired from source events, and checked before publication.
Follow a player or switch between casual and analytical stories. English, Hindi and Spanish templates preserve the approved facts. Unsupported model prose stays outside published narration.

The broadcast studio exports timed, verified graphics with source IDs. Vercel can serve the interactive replay while Render runs verification and the trained result model. Local language model inference remains on your own computer.
MatchWeave AI. Every moment has a story. Every fan gets their version.
